heading: Made in the lanes of Bhaktapur
intro: Vibeshots started with one camera, a scooter and weddings in our own neighbourhood. Today we're a small photo and film studio in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur: wedding photographers and cinematographers for Hindu and Newari weddings across the Kathmandu Valley, plus commercial work across Nepal.

values.title: Quiet on the day
values.text: We know the rituals and stay out of the way, so families can be themselves.

values.title: Honest edits
